contrast: (balanced - plain) for A1 minus (balanced - plain) for released official model
paired_on: same input timestamps, preprocessed pixels, prompts and queries across both models. Within each model only the prompt changes.
inference: Both models use RL checkpoints. The contrast estimates a difference in prompt response between two weights.
sampling: 10,000 paired source-video bootstrap draws, seed 0, percentiles 2.5 and 97.5.
